scope: Any year · under 20k miles · clean title · nationwide
title: What Each Car Has Been Through
lead: 52 Spider listings under 20k miles on CARFAX. 10 ranked, every CARFAX read line by line.
facts: McLaren Charlotte Papaya Spark: $279,900, $9,900 over the cap, 4 owners
Cheapest one is a branded title
takeaway: My two cents: McLaren San Francisco's one-owner 2020 at $269,991 is the pick inside your cap; push it to $250k since 2020 Spiders sold for $229k to $254k. Ilusso's 2021 is the nicest and the closest, but $279,900 is $9,900 over the cap: only at $270k. Skip the $230k McLaren Chicago car, it has a branded title.
shift: McLaren Chicago 2020 at $230,300 and Live Car Orlando: branded titles. Autodynamics Houston: damage reported. Lapin Scottsdale: 5 owners and a duplicate title
sources: Listings and full CARFAX reports from carfax.com dealer listings (free reports), read Nov 7, 2026. Sold results from classic.com and Cars & Bids via Codex, Nov 7. Days listed from CARFAX first-seen dates. MSRP from the CARFAX listing where shown. Window stickers and option lists: every dealer site checked VIN by VIN Nov 7 (iPacket, documents, description); a card says "Dealer site: no sticker" only after that check.

cars.verdict: $9,900 over the cap. The local one, with its window sticker on Ilusso's site ($345,600 MSRP). Only at $270k or less. A 2021 with 5,287 mi, dealer-serviced, no repairs, and it sits 15 minutes away at Ilusso, where we already have a contact. cars.verdict: $9,996 over the cap at $279,996. The Papaya Spark: MSO paint, carbon pack 1, forged wheels, ceramic brakes, 360 camera, around $55k in dealer-priced options. Clean CARFAX, but 4 owners (one for 6 months) and a car driven 1,250 mi in almost 4 years. Fresh sale-prep service helps; gearbox oil and spark plugs are not on record. CARFAX Value is $276,270 and $283,076 with fees. Dealer listing says "extended warranty available": a paid plan, not McLaren Qualified CPO. Get the price and terms in writing. 2020 Spiders sold $229k to $254k, so only at $270k or less.
